name: Amina Mama
shortBio: Nigerian-British feminist psychologist and theorist of postcolonial subjectivity who bridged Black psychology, African feminist epistemology, and critiques of state militarism.
centralQuestion: How do racialized and gendered power structures shape Black women’s interior subjectivity without reducing them to passive victims?

keyWorks.title: Beyond the Masks: Race, Gender and Subjectivity
keyWorks.description: Critiques Eurocentric psychology and develops a discourse-analytic account of Black women’s dynamic postcolonial subjectivity.
